description: ESCALATED — CONTRADICTION flag: HIGH-vuln high-income client (age 61, advanced knowledge) + global_equity_etf → rule engine SUITABLE → A4 contradiction triggers escalation despite strong financial profile.
client_narrative: Roberto Ferreira is 61 years old. Their gross annual income is approximately 80,000 euros (around 6,667 euros per month). They hold 500,000 euros in liquid savings and wish to invest 100,000 euros with a 8-year investment horizon. In terms of financial background, the client has advanced investment experience spanning equities, bonds, funds, derivatives, and structured products. Their investment approach is moderate — they rate their risk tolerance at 6 out of 10. They have confirmed they can afford to lose the entire 100,000 euros if the investment performs poorly. They have been assessed as financially vulnerable.
product_narrative: The product is a passively managed exchange-traded fund that tracks the MSCI World Index, providing diversified exposure to approximately 1,500 large and mid-cap equities across 23 developed markets. The fund is listed on major European exchanges, trades intraday with high liquidity, publishes a KID, contains no embedded derivatives, and uses no leverage. The recommended minimum investment horizon is five years.
